name: Wave
summary: Browse, install and update XP3800 apps and system mods
description: Wave brings apps and system mods from Git sources to your Sonim XP3800. Browse packages, check what is installed, and review changes before updating.
author: thooton

changes.text: Draw Markdown tables in package descriptions.
Confirm is black at rest like every Wave button.
Cydia-style Confirm screen and plainer messages.
Continue Queuing, OK on Installed, See Version History.
Simplify package details and show catalog folders.
Replace the confirm screen with a confirm sheet.
Rename Home sections to Device and Links; allow T9 in Search.
Move Home root status below the welcome header.
Publish Wave with the checked-in debug key.
